answer: For an archive of oasis maps and voyage logs, propose one vote per ID retaining 1 GiB of independent random audit blocks unique to that ID. Auditors issue blocks once, publish Merkle roots, then demand random blocks and proofs within 2 seconds hourly. Failure removes that ID's vote for the epoch. No block counts twice: n compliant IDs need n GiB, so a Sybil spiral incurs linear storage cost. Sampling can miss deletions; fast fetching or auditor collusion can bypass checks. This prices IDs, not people.
